The specific capacity was therefore 0.73 gpm/ft at this flow rate. Produced water was clear and free of silt, sand or clay. WELL COMMENTS: The existing 60 HP line-shaft turbine pump and 330 volt electric power supply source were utilized. The pump was raised and shifted to the side of the casing so that a 1-inch PVC pipe could be attached as a sounder line to an existing hole in the pump bottom plate . The pump was then shifted back to its original position over the casing. A 300 psi MiniTroll transducer was installed for continuous water-level data collection. The transducer was programmed to read and record water levels at one-minute intervals. A short section of existing discharge line was removed and a new section of steel discharge line, shop-fabricated by Coats was installed. The replacement section had two ports cut out to accommodate the installation of inflow meters. Two McCrometer in-line flow meters were installed, each capable of displaying instantaneous discharge in gallons per minute (gpm) and cumulative discharge in acre-feet (ac-ft). The first meter (meter closest to well) was installed on a horizontal section of the discharge pipe. The second meter was installed downstream of the first meter in a vertical section of the discharge pipe.
PUMP TEST COMMENTS: Drawdown transmissivity range from 55,800-189,800 gpd/ft and recovery transmissivity range from 36,500-158,200 gpd/ft. Pump Test Plots provided in Appendix A.
